prompt: With digit1, carry tote_1 to the handoff point and hold it there. Place it on line_feed as soon as the line controller sends "TUGGER DOCKED" on channel "line".
why: RoboLang 2.1 (0043): a `wait until message_received ...` with the world's channel and sender (a program). Before L4 (2.0): A condition can only test world facts; `message_received` is reserved and not implemented (language reference: 'message waits'), and the line controller is not a robot or sensor in this world.

paths.when: TUGGER DOCKED arrives from the line controller at 90 seconds
no message arrives: the wait times out and the run fails
